answer_text:
Here are some interesting and weird habits that many people have — and you might even recognize a few in yourself! 😄

---

### 1. 🗣️ **Talking to Inanimate Objects**
Many people have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it freezes at the worst possible moment.

---

### 2. 🚿 **Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower**
The shower seems to be the perfect place to rehearse arguments. The most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while shampooing your hair — long after the moment has passed.

---

### 3. 👃 **Smelling Weird Things**
Some people think old books smell wonderful, but others cannot get enough of smelling things like their own fingernails, mildew-scented towels, Play-Doh, and even laundry detergent. Some people literally cannot get through a day without smelling some downright oddities.

---

### 4. 🗑️ **Folding Trash Neatly**
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, or gum wrappers — folding everything into a neat square once they're done with it.

---

### 5. 🎨 **Doodling During Phone Calls**
Some people doodle during phone calls to help keep them focused, and sometimes they don't even know they're doing it until they're off the phone.

---

### 6. 🧠 **Having Full Conversations in Your Head**
Some people have full-blown conversations in their heads and then accidentally ask someone a question mid-conversation — only for the other person to look confused because they didn't hear the first part.

---

### 7. 🐶 **Telling Objects to "Stay"**
Some people, every time they set down a breakable object or something they don't want to misplace, point at it and tell it to "stay" out loud — like you would to a dog — even acknowledging that the object couldn't listen even if it wanted to.

---

### 8. 🍽️ **Eating Foods Separately**
Some people eat all the items on their plate separately — for example, finishing all the chicken before touching the broccoli — not realizing this was considered unusual until someone pointed it out.

---

### 9. 🏃 **Running from the Lights After Turning Them Off**
Some people bolt toward their room as soon as they switch off the hall light, convinced that if they ever look back, something creepy from a horror movie will be right behind them — while others try to be braver by walking slowly and singing loudly.

---

### 10. 🛒 **Feeling Guilty Leaving a Store Empty-Handed**
Many people feel guilty or like a criminal when walking out of a store without buying anything.

---

### 11. 📖 **Reading the Last Page First**
Some people have to read the last page of a book before they can start it from the beginning.

---

### 12. 🍴 **Scoring the Top of New Food Containers**
Some families have a quirk of opening a new food container and, if the food has a flat surface (like peanut butter, ice cream, or a tub of butter), taking a butter knife and creating a grid pattern on the top.

---

We all have an odd habit or two — and as it turns out, some of our tendencies are more common than you might think! Do any of these sound familiar to you? 😄
